license: NCBI GEO open reuse policy; no source-specific restriction found; not asserted CC-BY or CC0
pretraining: None; source FPKM aligned per library with Tophat2/Cufflinks, no learned shared atlas, embeddings, annotation, or imputation used

fields.X: per-pool FPKM; not single-cell counts or official log-expression
fields.region: observed epiblast A/P/L/R; deposited L/R are mirror reversed
fields.pd_ordinal: derived normalized section rank; NOT measured physical coordinate
fields.ap_category: derived categorical coding A=-1 P=+1 L/R=0; NOT measured physical coordinate

limitations: Only epiblast, ~20 cells per pool, no extraembryonic/mesoderm/endoderm completeness.
No measured 3D surface or volume; does not supply target occupancy or cell counts.
Relative gene-space coupling only; absolute FPKM must not be substituted for official expression.
Cross-platform information gain requires matched no-external and shuffled coupling controls.
Time transfer E7.0 to E7.5 is an unvalidated prior, tune only on allowed stage replicates.
held_out_access: No held-out expression/coordinates downloaded; only bibliographic and stage metadata for source triage.
quarantined_source: GSE171588 allowed-stage FPKM retained as REVIEW_HOLD: blanket GSM processing mentions ComBat; cross-stage scope cannot be conclusively reconstructed. Do not use. Harland2025 integrated/imputed/learned labels excluded.
